45_H.role: Pati-Salam/PQ-breaking option; supplies the surviving (1,1,3) needed by the verified G422 beta coefficients

126bar_H.role: G422 -> SM breaking at M_I and Yukawa sector
126bar_H.field_reality_note: implemented as the complex self-dual 126 tensor with its complex conjugate appearing in the potential

10C_H.role: complex SO(10) 10 required for a realistic renormalizable Yukawa sector; supplies the electroweak bidoublet
10C_H.field_reality_note: complex 10, equivalent to two copies of a real 10; this is consistent with treating the surviving (1,2,2) as a complex scalar in the beta-function registry

protected_I_sector.role: generate the informational (1,2,+1/2) state near 13.49 TeV without the excluded unprotected GUT portal

scalar_potential_provenance.45_126_10C_complete_renormalizable_refer: arXiv:2304.14227, Eqs. (2)-(7), with completeness cross-check by Hilbert-series counting
scalar_potential_provenance.210_extension: OPEN: must be enumerated explicitly before the UV action can be called frozen
scalar_potential_provenance.protected_I_extension: OPEN: must be specified together with an exact/collective/sequestered protection symmetry and all renormalizable portals

hard_invariants: The scalar potential must contain every representation whose surviving component is used by the verified beta-function registry.
Removing 45_H or its (1,1,3) state invalidates the current G422 coefficient matrix and forces a fresh RGE derivation.
The electroweak/Yukawa 10 must be complex if the branch claims the standard realistic renormalizable 10+126 Yukawa structure.
No heavy threshold mass may be chosen after inspecting gauge unification; masses must be outputs of the frozen potential.
No new SO(10) representation may be added unless an existing hard gate fails and the branch state is explicitly revised.
The protected informational sector must remove or symmetry-suppress the renormalizable I mass and norm portals; the ordinary embedded-doublet branch is already FAIL.

The known complete 45+126+10C renormalizable potential is a core sub-potential only; adding 210_H and a protected I sector creates additional invariants that must be exhaustively enumerated rather than assumed absent.

current_verified_gauge_target.qualification: gauge-only two-loop EFT target before derived heavy thresholds

next_gate: enumerate the complete renormalizable invariant basis for 210_H + 45_H + 126bar_H + 10C_H + protected_I_sector, then derive the vacuum and Hessian; the 45+126+10C core is source-complete, but 210 and I-sector invariants remain open
